name: A mistaken word is retired at the cost of its addition: the FAE case and the harness that cannot repeat it
asks: Leader, 2026-09-11: "I misspoke ONCE like 2 weeks ago and said 'FAE' to describe FeltOS. And we have been paying for that HARDCORE since"; "OVERHAUL NOT PATCH … never ever 'fixes' but always 'aligns'". Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: metroplat-feltos-node pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: An agent's mistake costs the house no more to remove than it cost to add; the harness makes the mistake impossible to repeat.

requirements.says: The harness mistake ledger shall record each recurrence of a named mistake, with the sessions and cost spent on it, beginning with every mention of "FAE" in Claude and Codex sessions.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "track, in Codex and Claude sessions, mentions of 'FAE' … to study how expensive it is to remove a mistake, once an agent has made it, in our environment".

requirements.says: The house glossary shall define FAE as a descriptor of FeltOS and a category of app, and shall record that no package named fae is wanted.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11: "'flatfile agent engine' was a DESCRIPTOR used for FeltOS"; "FAE is a category of app we have"; "the fae package … I NEVER FUCKING WANTED".

requirements.says: The tree shall contain no package named fae and no dependency on one, verified by the tree itself and not by an agent's report.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11: asked dozens of times for the fae package's removal; agents reported success; Claude's install failed because MetroPlat pinned FAE 0.1.7; "drop fae dependency from metroplat" is the wrong frame.

requirements.says: The harness shall give an agent the context of the house's systems before it generates code or prose, and shall receive the agent's output into those systems for moderation.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "necessarily being fed context from, and context into, our systems, such that they can provide the moderation capabilities you lack".

requirements.says: The harness shall state its work as alignment to the theory's condition and shall not name an agent's act "fix".
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "Make it so that your CTO, all engineer, all shit, never ever 'fixes' but always 'aligns'"; changing "to make it better" differs from changing "it to be how it should".

requirements.says: The harness assessment shall state what a coding-agent harness for a mid-level engineer requires in September 2026 and how much of it the house has.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "What does a coding agent harness of a mid-level engineer require, in september 2026? How much of that do you have?"; the outside-auditor reading.

requirements.says: The harness shall carry a Leader's statement into method once, so that the Leader states it exactly once.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "I should have to say shit exactly ONCE. And then it goes into systems that make sure it is knowledge".

conditions.says: A search of the tree finds no fae package or dependency.
The ledger holds a count of FAE mentions and the sessions spent.

board-opening.context: Theory: the 2026-10-10 note on the cost of removing a mistake. The align operator is held in the engineering glossary.
